_about: Pip & Biscuit 3D episodes made with Higgsfield (Grok Video 1.5, 720p, 15 s, about 67.5 credits each). Frames are Higgsfield image job IDs: pass one as start_image (it can't be combined with reference images). New frames: gpt_image_2_6, 9:16, quality medium, with the playroom frame as image_references (1 credit each).

episodes.heard: Hey, Biscuit! Let's build it together! ... Hey, we did it!
episodes.title: Biscuit Knocked Over Pip's Tower! 😮🧱 Let's Build It Together #forkids
episodes.description:
Pip builds a super tall block tower... and Biscuit wants to help! Uh-oh! Can they build it again, together? A tiny lesson about teamwork for little ones.

#forkids #kidscartoon #shorts #teamwork #preschool

episodes.heard: Let's take turns, Biscuit! Good boy!
episodes.title: Pip Won't Share Her Ball! 🔴🐶 Taking Turns #forkids
episodes.description:
Pip has a bouncy red ball and Biscuit wants to play too! Can Pip learn to share? A little story about taking turns for toddlers and preschoolers.

#forkids #kidscartoon #shorts #sharing #takingturns #preschool

episodes.note: Cut at 9.2 s with a 1 s hold on the last frame: in the generated clip the mud came back after 9.5 s (the model ignored 'all clean'). To restore the full ending, generate a 5 s clip (22.5 credits) from a still of the raw clip at 9.0 s showing the hands rinsed clean and Pip saying 'All clean!', then join the two with pipeline/assemble.sh.
episodes.title: Bubbles on Biscuit's Nose! 🫧🐶 Scrub Scrub Scrub #forkids
episodes.description:
Muddy hands and muddy paws! Pip and Biscuit wash up with lots and lots of bubbles. Scrub, scrub, scrub! A bubbly little lesson about washing hands for toddlers and preschoolers.

#forkids #kidscartoon #shorts #washyourhands #preschool
